svg.title: Why do we score the receiving account?
svg.desc: Three stages read top to bottom. Every sender-side check passes: device, location, login all look normal. Money arrives at the account from several strangers with no shared history. The same money leaves again within 24 hours, to new accounts. The receiving account is scored instead of the transaction.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
